items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: Were you listening to somebody special like Roy Brown or did you like Jim Turner or something?

ctx.x: No, I just, you know, it wasn't really, I don't know, nobody really taught me. I was just fooling around and had a couple of friends at pianos. We used to go to each other's houses and we just bang on the piano. So I just picked it up from that.
Were you listening to somebody special like Roy Brown or did you like Jim Turner or something? No.
Well, no, not, I liked them all, but I didn't really learn anything from them. I just, I just, I just, I just liked music.
